name: jbrain-retrieval-v1-synthetic
description: Hand-authored fictional operational knowledge. Queries and judgments are public and authored with the corpus; this is a diagnostic baseline, not a held-out or external benchmark. Relevance labels identify evidence-bearing documents, not every topically related document.

documents.title: Atlas payment gateway
documents.description: Current project ownership and production location.
documents.body:
Atlas handles merchant payment authorization. Mira Sen owns Atlas. Atlas runs in ap-south-1.
See [production architecture](/projects/atlas-architecture.md), [runbook](/operations/atlas-runbook.md), and [Mira](/people/mira-sen.md).

documents.title: Atlas production architecture
documents.description: Current production datastore and connection limits.
documents.body:
Atlas uses PostgreSQL 16 as its primary database. Connection pooling uses PgBouncer with a maximum of 120 server connections. The API is written in Go.
See [Atlas](/projects/atlas.md) and [pool exhaustion incident](/incidents/atlas-pool-exhaustion.md).

documents.title: Atlas database proposal — archived
documents.body:
Archived 2023 proposal: Atlas would use MySQL 8. This proposal was superseded and is not the production decision.
See [current production architecture](/projects/atlas-architecture.md).

documents.title: Atlas operations runbook
documents.body:
Atlas has a 99.95 percent availability SLO. Retry keys remain valid for 48 hours. Webhook acknowledgements must finish within 10 seconds.
See [Atlas](/projects/atlas.md).

documents.title: Atlas credential rotation
documents.body:
Atlas API credentials rotate every 90 days. Emergency credential revocation is owned by Leena Rao.
See [Atlas](/projects/atlas.md).

documents.title: Atlas pool exhaustion incident
documents.description: Root cause and mitigation of the April outage.
documents.body:
On 2026-04-20 Atlas failed because idle transactions exhausted the database pool. The mitigation was a 30 second idle transaction timeout. Mira Sen coordinated the incident.
See [architecture](/projects/atlas-architecture.md).

documents.title: Boreal telemetry collector
documents.body:
Jon Iyer owns Boreal. Boreal collects device telemetry. Raw events are stored in S3.
See [retention](/policies/boreal-retention.md) and [Jon](/people/jon-iyer.md).

documents.title: Boreal data retention
documents.description: Current log and metric retention policy.
documents.body:
Boreal retains raw logs for 30 days and aggregated metrics for 90 days. Legal holds suspend log deletion.
See [Boreal](/projects/boreal.md).

documents.title: Mira Sen
documents.body:
Mira Sen works on the Platform team at Nimbus Labs. Mira is based in Pune.
See [Atlas](/projects/atlas.md) and [Nimbus](/companies/nimbus.md).

documents.title: Jon Iyer
documents.body:
Jon Iyer works on the Infrastructure team at Nimbus Labs. Jon is based in Delhi.
See [Boreal](/projects/boreal.md).

documents.title: Nimbus Labs
documents.body: Nimbus Labs is headquartered in Bengaluru. Zoya Shah is its security director. The company builds payment and telemetry software.

documents.title: Infrastructure budget 2026
documents.body: The approved 2026 infrastructure budget is USD 48000 per month. Leena Rao approves increases above USD 5000.

documents.title: Infrastructure budget 2025 — archived
documents.body: The 2025 infrastructure budget was USD 36000 per month. This historical budget is superseded by the 2026 approval.

documents.title: WireGuard remote access
documents.body: Remote production access uses WireGuard on UDP port 51820. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory. Contractors receive access for seven days.

documents.title: Recovery snapshot policy
documents.body: Database snapshots run daily at 02:00 UTC. Snapshots are retained for 14 days. A restore drill is required every quarter.

documents.title: Deployment rollback procedure
documents.description: Returning production to a working release.
documents.body: A failed release is reverted by redeploying the last healthy image digest. Preserve the release marker before rollback.

documents.title: Employee expenses
documents.body: Employee meal reimbursement is capped at INR 750 per day. Receipts are mandatory above INR 200. Claims must be filed within 21 days.

documents.title: Merchant refund policy
documents.body: Merchant refunds are accepted within 14 days of settlement. Disputed transactions require manual review.

documents.title: Rover camera transport
documents.body: The Rover camera streams video over RTSP on TCP port 8554. H.264 is the supported codec.

documents.title: Rover battery maintenance
documents.body: Replace a Rover battery after 300 charge cycles or when capacity falls below 80 percent. Store batteries at 50 percent charge.

documents.title: Harbor artifact registry
documents.body:
Harbor keeps deployment images for 60 days. Priya Das owns Harbor.
See [deployment rollback](/operations/deploy.md).

documents.title: Cedar reporting service
documents.description: Reporting service cache and output formats.
documents.body: Cedar uses Redis for short-lived report caches. Cache entries expire after 15 minutes. Cedar reports are exported as CSV.

documents.title: Café onboarding guide
documents.body: New hires visit Café Étoile on Tuesday for equipment collection. The help desk opens at 09:30.

documents.title: 東京オフィス安全方針
documents.description: 東京オフィスの安全情報。
documents.body: 東京オフィスの避難場所は中央公園です。緊急連絡先は佐藤です。

documents.title: Search architecture decision
documents.body: The knowledge store uses keyword ranking and explicit document links. Semantic embeddings were deferred to keep the service small.

documents.title: Service token policy
documents.body: Service tokens expire after 24 hours. Machine credentials are supplied through environment variables. Never include tokens in logs.
